name: Eidren
description: New taercenn and later Wilt-Leaf Vigilant who sacrifices his life to protect Mistmeadow.

description_citations.text: "Gryffid". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eidren orders hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a beautiful pattern, creating the Gilt-Leaf Wood.
timeline.quote: Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana, ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful.

citation.text: Leaf Gilder (Lorwyn, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gryffid comes to respect his new commander Eidren and hunts Rhys until the Great Aurora; when he catches Rhys, Eidren offers Rhys a return to the Gilt-Leaf.
timeline.quote: When he finally caught Rhys, Eidren dismissed Gryffid and made Rhys an offer to return to the Gilt-Leaf

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Mistmeadow Gryffid sees fae carry Rhys away at Maralen's orders; Eidren sacrifices his life, and Gryffid brings his remains to Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: When Eidren sacrificed his life to protect Mistmeadow

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: under the command of Vigilant Eidren
